lines.en: I walk into the woods over wet mud.

lines.zh: 袍角拖过草地,留下水痕
lines.en: My robe drags a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我的步子和人一样,却更沉
lines.en: My stride is human, but heavier.
I pass around a dead tree.

lines.zh: 海嗣的骨节在皮下沉响
lines.en: Seaborn joints click beneath my skin.
I move slowly up the path.
These fingers are not a human's.
I lower my head and sniff the air.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都蔫了
lines.en: The grass wilts where I pass.
I keep an unhurried pace in the woods.
There are village lights far off.
I turn my heavy steps that way.

lines.zh: 身上还挂着海水的味道
lines.en: Sea water still clings to me.
I stop and listen a while.
Something moves under the robe.

lines.zh: 我一步步靠近有人的地方
lines.en: Step by step, I near where people are.
I stand, robe hanging to the ground.

lines.zh: 有什么在我体内慢慢长
lines.en: Something is slowly growing inside me.
I tilt my head as if hearing the sea.
My fingers twitch.
My breathing is far slower than a human's.

lines.zh: 海嗣化的女巫，还在配药。
lines.en: The oceanized witch still brews.
The woods are unnaturally quiet.
I lift a hand and look at it.
Something shifts inside my body.
I open my mouth slowly, then close it.
The wind lifts my robe.

lines.zh: 我在等一个更方便的时刻
lines.en: I am waiting for a better moment.
The soil under me is wet.
I hear that sound again.

lines.zh: 活人的气味，盖过了海水。
lines.en: A living person's scent over the salt.
I raise my head and look at you.
You are smaller than I remember.
I tilt my head as if to recognise you.

lines.zh: 你的村子离这里不远吧
lines.en: Your village is not far, is it?
I reach out, then draw back.
You keep stepping back.
I am in no hurry; I can wait.
There is distance between us.
I smile, slowly.
I step back; my robe sways.
This body still feels pain.
Seawater runs from the wound.
Salt water seeps through my robe
No matter; I will grow it back.
You interrupted me.
I draw one slow breath.

lines.zh: 这具身体比想象中脆弱
lines.en: This body is frailer than expected.
I catch hold of the trunk beside me.
I will remember your hand.
That smell comes from you.
The air you exhale smells better than food
I offer an upturned palm.

lines.zh: 这具身体还留着人的胃口
lines.en: This body still keeps a human appetite.
I am not fussy; anything living will do.
I smell more keenly than a human.
Come closer; I will not bite.
This little is not enough.
I shuffle a few steps after you.
Your warmth is tempting.

lines.zh: 你撞在我袍子上,像撞到湿布
lines.en: You hit my robe like wet cloth.
I do not shift at all.
My hand settles on your shoulder.
Do not stand against my robe.
This body is harder than a human's.
I step back, not from fear.
You stepped on my hem.
The cold damp creeps up your arm.

lines.zh: 我的药瓶里，装的是海水。
lines.en: My bottles are filled with seawater.
My wet robe brushes your arm

lines.zh: 这种事,这具身体还记得
lines.en: This body still remembers such things.
I lift my robe a little.
My body is colder than a human's.
Hold my hand; it will feel cold.
Seawater seeps out beneath us.
We walk to the water together.
Something inside me answers.
I speak slowly; do not rush me.

lines.zh: 这具身体在改变,你看见了吗
lines.en: This body is changing; do you see?
Whatever happens, do not let go.
I reach down and take it.
This is not from the sea.

lines.zh: 这具手还记得怎么握东西
lines.en: This hand still remembers how to hold things
I lean in and sniff it.
If it is useful, I keep it.
It grows wet in my hand.

lines.zh: 这具身体知道怎么用它
lines.en: This body knows how to use it.
I tuck it into my robe.
Whose pocket did this fall from?
My palm closes, and it soaks through
Then it can only be you.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你的位置，药锅也开了。
lines.en: I have your position, and my cauldron is open.
You are not retreating fast enough.
My fingers are raised.
There is no one else in these woods.
You have become the quarry.

lines.zh: 我的袍角拖过草地，留下水痕。
lines.en: My robe drags the grass, leaving a wet trail.
Do you hear the water?
I will not let you leave my sight.
This body remembers how to kill.
You turn behind a tree; I am still watching.
You are running toward the village.

lines.zh: 我走得不快,但你甩不掉
lines.en: I am not fast, but you cannot shake me.
Water seeps from under my feet.
I am very patient.
Each time you look back, I am closer.
This body does not need to pant.
The distance keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 鞋底的水印，一直跟着你
lines.en: Wet footprints trail you wherever you go
This one I will not miss.
My hand closes on you.
Seawater pours into the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下不是人手能挡的
lines.en: No human hand can block this.

lines.zh: 我张开的嘴里全是海水
lines.en: My open mouth is full of seawater.
You struggle hard.

lines.zh: 这具身体的力量比看起来大
lines.en: This body is stronger than it looks.
I let go, and you fall.
I draw back slowly.

lines.zh: 海嗣的女巫，药水换成咸的。
lines.en: A seaborn witch brews her potions saltier.
Do not bother getting up.
I rise out of the wet mud.
My robe surfaces first.
The smell of seawater thickens.
This body used to be a person.

lines.zh: 树林里的鸟忽然都停了
lines.en: The birds in the woods go silent.
The grass beneath me withers fast.
I crawl up out of the water.
The seaborn has come ashore.
The air here is too dry.
You had best not stand there.
My robe and skin burn together.
I fall into the mud, bones out of place.
Seawater should not choke me.
The blast tears my robe open.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我的肩
lines.en: Something sharp lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股力量想把我推回海里
lines.en: That force tries to push me back to the sea.
This body is eating itself.

lines.zh: 雷打在湿袍子上,全身发麻
lines.en: Lightning on wet cloth leaves me numb.
There is not even sea here.
